note: Round-20 core and JNI fixes: a scalar multipart field with limit = "unlimited" keeps the bounded scalar cap instead of buffering up to the request-wide aggregate; the cron timer thread start is retried on the next call after a failed spawn instead of caching a dead timer; header-first JNI fallbacks (invalid input, null streams, setup failure, runtime unavailable, panic) deliver their body through the OutputStream, not only the header, so the client gets the error text; dispatchDirect0 / DirectStash docs state that the input checks run before the 1 KiB out-buffer rule.
